annotation.title_en: The Scammer Husband and the Blood Donor
annotation.summary_en: A man explains his insurance fraud scheme involving his wife's surgeries to a friend, but refuses to donate blood to a dying foreigner for fear the foreigner will scam him back.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins in a hospital lobby where two friends meet. One man reveals his elaborate scam: he brings his wife (the daughter of a wealthy man) for unnecessary appendicitis surgeries every week because they have a medical insurance contract. He admits he splits the insurance payouts with the surgeons to 'squeeze' money out of the insurance company and his rich father-in-law. The scene shifts to the urgency of an operating room where a surgeon and nurse are treating a rich foreigner involved in a car accident. The patient has internal bleeding and needs a rare Type 4 Negative blood transfusion. The doctor identifies that one of the men in the lobby has this exact blood type. Despite the doctor offering increasing amounts of money—from $1,000 up to $10,000—the man flatly refuses to donate. When his friend asks why he won't help for such a large sum, the man delivers the punchline: he is such a professional scammer that he believes if even one drop of his blood enters the foreigner's body, the foreigner will wake up with his personality and scam them all.
catchphrases: Ախպերս իմ արյունից որ մի կաթիլ սրա օրգանիզմ գնաց, էսի որ զարթնեց, իմացի մեզի հաստատ քցելուա։
